method: Read the complete five-file diff, full Sidebar and SidebarManagementDialog, Workspace topbar and desktop/mobile Sidebar callers, affected CSS rules and existing responsive/root-badge CSS. Trace removed labels/selectors and accessible names; check reported test JSON and exact source hashes without rerunning tests.

checks.result: RootExecutionNotice is immediately before connection and after flex:1/min-width:0 breadcrumb. Same execution identity, confirmed status and settings callback retained; no mutation added. Notice is inline-flex with flex-shrink:0; button white-space:nowrap; topbar remains one flex row.

One flex sidebar-list-tools row contains named 会话排序 select and 刷新会话列表 button. Optional absent sort still leaves refresh. Callback values, project ownership, search, archive, pagination and row actions remain unchanged; project-named nav preserves list accessibility.

Shared Sidebar is reused in mobile Dialog. Sort label flex:1/min-width:0 with width:100% select and refresh flex-shrink:0 avoids intrinsic width pushing the row. Existing mobile topbar truncates breadcrumb, renders connection as a dot and hides desktop-only actions. ROOT has no wrap. This is CSS/DOM review, not measured browser geometry.

Removed recent/search/archive heading row has no remaining old 最近会话 references in web source. Deleted project-conversations sidebar-section override has no remaining consumer; generic sidebar-section still serves Project. SidebarManagementDialog refers to existing 已归档 control and project conversation list.

Author run-5L3Cvy records 4 files/33 passed/0 failed. Tested source hashes match four current files; SidebarManagementDialog has the disclosed post-test copy-only wording correction. Read both final sentences and verified event handlers unchanged; do not claim exact final dialog hash was rerun.

limits: No tests, build, source edits, browser operation, remote operation, commit or deployment performed for this independent review.
No independent pixel/overflow measurement or physical-device interaction; parent owns visual acceptance.
Narrow layout and adjacent caller review, not a new whole-repository audit.
